content.text: MySQL is up. Now apply migrations, set utf8mb4 config, and configure root password.

input.command:
set -e
# Apply migrations in order
for f in /testbed/migrations/*.sql.gz; do echo "Applying $f"; zcat "$f" | mysql; done
# Set server-wide utf8mb4
cat > /etc/mysql/mysql.conf.d/zz-benchmark.cnf <<'EOF'
[mysqld]
character-set-server=utf8mb4
collation-server=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
[client]
default-character-set=utf8mb4
EOF
# Configure root password access
mysql <<'EOF'
ALTER USER 'root'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED WITH mysql_native_password BY 'root';
CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS 'root'@'127.0.0.1' IDENTIFIED WITH mysql_native_password BY 'root';
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON *.* TO 'root'@'127.0.0.1' WITH GRANT OPTION;
GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON *.* TO 'root'@'localhost' WITH GRANT OPTION;
FLUSH PRIVILEGES;
EOF
# Convenience cnf so `mysql` works without args too
cat > /root/.my.cnf <<'EOF'
[client]
user=root
password=root
default-character-set=utf8mb4
EOF
chmod 600 /root/.my.cnf
echo "CONFIG DONE"
input.description: Apply migrations and configure root password and utf8mb4
